mapper.select: SELECT stats_task_id AS statsTaskId, debounce_seconds AS debounceSeconds, auto_clean_package AS autoCleanPackage, swing_direction_filter AS swingDirectionFilter FROM access_clean_task_settings WHERE stats_task_id = #{statsTaskId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO access_clean_task_settings (stats_task_id, debounce_seconds, auto_clean_package, swing_direction_filter) VALUES (#{statsTaskId}, #{debounceSeconds}, #{autoCleanPackage}, #{swingDirectionFilter}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE debounce_seconds = #{debounceSeconds}, auto_clean_package = #{autoCleanPackage}, swing_direction_filter = #{swingDirectionFilter}
